meta.homeTitle: Hazorasp-Textil | Uzbek Cotton Yarn Manufacturer & Exporter
meta.homeDescription: Hazorasp-Textil LLC is a direct manufacturer of 100% Uzbek cotton carded ring-spun yarn for knitting, established in 2017 in Hazorasp District, Khorezm Region. With capacity up to 400 MT per month, we supply international textile markets.

hero.sub: A cotton yarn manufacturer built to the standards international textile partners require — from fiber intake to finished cone.

about.title: Built to grow Uzbekistan's textile industry
about.lede: Hazorasp-Textil LLC is a direct manufacturer of 100% cotton carded ring-spun yarn for knitting, established in 2017 in Hazorasp District, Khorezm Region.
about.history: Hazorasp-Textil LLC was established in 2017 to advance Uzbekistan's textile industry by converting locally grown cotton into high-value yarn. The company is a direct manufacturer with capacity up to 400 MT per month, supplying carded ring-spun yarn for knitting applications to international markets.
about.mission: To convert local cotton into high-quality yarn using modern technology, delivering reliable, consistent, internationally compliant products to our customers — and to contribute meaningfully to the development of Uzbekistan's textile industry.
about.vision: To become one of Central Asia's most trusted and innovative yarn producers, expanding our export footprint and building a nationally rooted brand recognized in international markets through a modern production culture.
about.quote: We run our operations on the principles of high quality, modern technology and mutual trust.
about.ceoMessage:
Dear partners and customers,

On behalf of the Hazorasp-Textil team, I welcome you.

We run our operations on the principles of high quality, modern technology and mutual trust. Building long-term, stable relationships with every partner is a goal we hold ourselves to. We believe that through quality products, a responsible approach and continuous innovation, we will remain a trusted partner — in Uzbekistan and in international markets alike.

production.title: From raw boll to finished cone
production.lede: Six controlled stages, each logged and tested before the fiber moves to the next.

steps.title: Cotton Receiving
steps.desc: Raw cotton is intake, weighed and graded by fiber batch on arrival from regional gins.

steps.title: Cleaning
steps.desc: Blow room lines remove trash, seed coat and short fiber before opening.

steps.title: Fiber Preparation
steps.desc: Carding and drawing align fibers into a uniform, controlled sliver.

steps.title: Spinning
steps.desc: Spinning frames twist the sliver into yarn at the specified count.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.desc: Every lot is tested for strength, evenness and count before release.

steps.title: Finished Yarn
steps.desc: Winding, conditioning and packaging to the buyer's shipping specification.

products.title: Yarn built to your specification
products.lede: Currently in production: 100% cotton carded ring-spun yarn for knitting. Available counts are Ne 20/1, 24/1, 26/1, 28/1 and 30/1. Samples of 20–50 kg are available for buyer approval.

items.name: Carded Cotton Yarn
items.desc: 100% cotton carded ring-spun yarn produced for knitting applications, available across five standard counts.
items.packaging: 2.4 kg cone; 24 cones per PP bag; 57.6 kg net per bag

quality.title: Tested before it ships, not after it's questioned
quality.lede: Fiber and yarn are checked at every stage of the line before a lot is released.

items.title: Fiber testing (HVI)
items.desc: Incoming cotton is measured for micronaire, length, strength and color grade before it enters production.

items.title: Yarn strength & evenness
items.desc: Count, tenacity, elongation and evenness are measured against recognized statistical benchmarks.

items.title: Moisture & conditioning
items.desc: Yarn is conditioned to standard atmosphere before final weighing and packing.

items.title: Contamination control
items.desc: Foreign fiber detection at blow room and winding stages protects downstream fabric quality.

certs.name: Quality management
certs.desc: Structured quality control at every production stage

certs.name: Product compliance
certs.desc: Testing procedures aligned with international textile practice

certs.name: Batch traceability
certs.desc: Field-to-cone batch records for every lot

certs.name: Continuous improvement
certs.desc: Equipment and processes upgraded to raise consistency

export.title: Reliable textile partner from Uzbekistan
export.copy: Hazorasp-Textil supplies international textile markets, including Turkey, China and India. We are interested in long-term partnerships with knitting factories, textile mills, yarn importers and distributors.

sustainability.title: Responsible by process, not by slogan
sustainability.lede: Resource use and waste handling are part of how the mill is run, not an afterthought.

items.title: Water stewardship
items.desc: Water-conscious practices are applied across production, with further efficiency measures planned as operations scale.

items.title: Energy efficiency
items.desc: Equipment and processes are selected with energy efficiency in mind, reducing consumption where possible.

items.title: Responsible sourcing
items.desc: Cotton by-products and production waste are handled responsibly rather than discarded.

items.title: Carded yarn line now running five standard counts
items.excerpt: Ne 20/1, 24/1, 26/1, 28/1 and 30/1 carded ring-spun cotton yarn are available for knitting.
